changed.what: Title names what the bead now owns (the derivation; entry schema, name map and lints are N32a-02's). S09 applied as option A (DESIGN, interface first): BD-022 dropped from deps; deps now BD-005, N32-REF, N32a-02, N32a-03, N35-REF, STD-E2E, STD-TEST (cycle-free, checked); BD-022 and BD-023 build from its members. on_cancel spelled leave|cancel_job (S09, S34); leave_running is 802. idempotency_key never in JSON-schema required, x-frob-key required|optional instead (DESIGN: strict MCP validation would turn a missing key into 802, so 805 was unreachable on MCP); 805 raised by N32a-09. 808 appended wherever the input has an int53 field, any kind (it was on read/run/mutate regardless and missing on admin). sync_wait_ms bounds from wait.mcp_ms/mcp_max_ms. New variation table (13 arms, each naming the bead that lands it): paginated, estimable, key_optional, int53, actions (this bead); needs_groups/790 (N33c-32); params 891/892/893 and 734/828 (this bead, matching N34-24 and N37-REF); override/override_reason (N28a-02, S09); from_proposal with 804 at /from_proposal (N28c-14, S77); machine with MACHINE_NOT_LOCAL once N35-33 issues the number (N41-12, S57 in corrected form); engine with N32ax-02's codes (S68). 990 never appended (S09) with test. Two-kind rule generalized to the eight verbs with actions: one action property (--action), flat union schema, wrong-action property is 802. Annotations rule (read_only, idempotent, destructive, open_world_hint), tags, and the short_doc format N32a-11 parses. New members common_properties() and annotations(); all_refusals carries each code's source; envelope_schema delegates to N32a-03. Lint common-property-shadowed (S68, corrected: covers kind and field properties, CLI flags and process options; run by N32a-02's build script); it catches session.show. 724 rule kept; its dispatch and test are BD-022's and N00-02's. Acceptance limited to what the bead and its deps deliver; script stages assigned to NJL-02 (1-3, 5, 6), BD-023 (4), BD-138 (7, needs N32a-09), skipped before; step 6 now uses synthetic.deferred with --key; step 7 uses session open, not design edit. Tests: needs_groups test moved to N33c-32 with a real group (S09); added key_never_schema_required, on_cancel_values, int53_drives_808, internal_fault_never_appended, annotations_rule, shadow_lint_catches, short_doc_format, envelope_schema_delegates, derivation_ignores_first_milestone, prop_derivation_closed; five registered mutants as negative controls.

S22 decided: every run/mutate call in a script passes --key; the helper never injects one (DESIGN, reasons stated; rejected the derived key). New helper e2e_key <label> (deterministic e2e-<script>-<label>, reuse in a run is exit 2 unless --again); e2e_cmd logs argv verbatim and prints a --key hint on an unexpected 805. S58 defined (DESIGN): @fixture:<name> denotes fixtures/<name> (file, the one file of the argument's format, every such file for a list argument, or the directory), passed verbatim and resolved by frob for artifact-input/identity/foreign-file parameters with the resolution echoed in bound; distinct from N24b-03's fixture:<name> and from @corpus/@archive/@workload; helper e2e_fixture logs path and SHA-256, --copy into work/. S70 aligned: e2e_scene_ready runs scene accept with --key e2e-ready-<run_id>-<scene_id>; linter rule scene-ready-before-run (BD-228) named. Isolation corrected: no frob --root and no FROB_HOME; e2e_init exports FROB_STATE=<scratch>/state (0700), work/ is cwd; scratch registries only through e2e_registries_scratch (FROB_REGISTRIES_ROOT, summary registries: override, gates_claimable false). Gauntlet: e2e_tier runs the six tier targets in the cargo form and logs the receipt hash (new cmd field receipt, summary receipts); linter rules self-recording (exempting the recorder's own scripts, N38b-19 and N38b-21), scratch-registries, tier-without-receipt. Script checks: frob-e2e check <name> with checks in src/e2e/checks/ and the test target e2e_scripts that seven beads already cite (built-in check single-envelope); assert kind check; helper e2e_check. Rule for a bead's own helper library and the reserved e2e_ prefix. Header seed defaults to 0. Idempotence criterion now substitutes the run identifier in argv, cmdline, paths. Attributions: frob.beadlog/1 is N29a-09's, the recorder is N38b-19. Unit tests and self-test fixtures added for every new helper and lint rule.

S11 applied: Control carries every field of BD-025's record (gate as a list, last_seen, feature, fixture, due, permanent, state Runnable|Obligation, removed_check); Controls::all added. control() outcomes Caught, Missed, Stale, Obligation (obligation records are not run; a catch for the wrong reason is Missed, N38b-04). GateReport precedence: Fail, then NotEligible(StaleControl), then NotEligible(NoControl) (no control caught, including only obligations), then Pass, with the texts N38a-02 and N38b-04 print; evidence statuses add stale and not-eligible with a reason field. KA Row brought to N38a-12's schema (owner, same_as, truth{kind,value}, sites list, control{text,nc}, label, printed, slug); assert_ka takes the site and reports obligation for to-set tolerance or a control with no NC, leaving derivation/rerun/unreconciled to N38a-12's eligibility. Relation record renamed RelationRow (N38a-14 has a Relation trait) with N38a-14's fields (sites, compare enum, bound, mutations as a list from table or array, entry, owner, due); prefix mr_<id>_ covers MR-Cnn. New Counterexamples parser of registry/counterexamples.toml (N38b-05's record), so that file also has one reader. Unknown fields are load errors. The number rule stated (KA/CX from N38a-40 blocks, NC by N38b-05 or BD-025's rules, refusal codes from N35-33 and N35x-02). Unit tests added for each; e2e script now also loads the four registries of record and logs row and obligation counts.

requests.what: Add dep NJL-01 (cycle-free: NJL-01 no longer depends on BD-022, checked with graph_check). Build each kind's common flags from VerbEntry::common_properties() (flags --key and --estimate, kebab case otherwise, --action <name> on an entry with actions, no per-action flag), so the CLI and MCP share one derivation. The --estimate row of the flag table reads 'every run verb, and verbs marked estimable'. Replace 'NJL-01 (which follows this bead...)': NJL-01 now comes first. Serve all_refusals() with each code's source (chapter, kind, field) in '<verb> --help --json' and robot-docs. Its process options (--json, --session) are listed in NJL-01's PROCESS_OPTIONS.

VerbTool reads input_schema_with_common_fields, envelope_schema, short_doc, tags and annotations() as now defined in NJL-01 (annotations: read_only only when every action is read; destructive for an admin entry or admin action). Its acceptance runs NJL-01's script stage 4.

Scope wording: NJL-01 now comes before BD-022 (it no longer 'follows BD-022'). Add params, released and needs_groups to the VerbEntry sketch. Add the entry field engines (native|reference|external, default ["native"]) for N32ax-02, and the action-table members destructive and paginated (VERBS-spark asked for the latter). The build script compiles NJL-01's derive.rs and runs RL-11 through its short_doc and the lint common-property-shadowed; the build script also reads registries/loop.toml for N28a-02's arm.
None required: NJL-01's envelope_schema member now delegates to its envelope_schema(entry); confirm that function's signature takes a VerbEntry.

Write the needs_groups arm of NJL-01's derive.rs (790 for a non-empty list) with the member and test registry_refusal_lists_generated, using a real group such as stats (gpu-cuda is not one of the ten).

Own the resolution of @fixture:<name> as STD-E2E defines it, for artifact-input<F>, artifact-identity<F> and foreign-file arguments: against the workspace fixtures/ directory whose path the build records (as N32ax-03 does for registries/), read only; a file, the one file of the parameter's format in a directory, every such file sorted for a list parameter; echo reference, path and digest in bound. Name the refusal for an unknown or ambiguous fixture, a number from N35-33 (none was invented). Confirm the params arms NJL-01 now implements (891 for artifact-input/ref/identity, 892 for identity, 893 for foreign-file; 734 and 828 for path-taking kinds).

Write variation 10 of NJL-01's derive.rs (override, override_reason from a requires row in registries/loop.toml) in the change that adds the property, with override_properties_generated. It already reaches NJL-01 transitively; a direct dep would make the edge visible.

Write variation 11 (from_proposal on every run entry, CLI --from-proposal <id>) in derive.rs. Cite FROB-REF-804 with pointer /from_proposal for a proposal whose inputs changed (it names the condition 'stale parent', exit 7, with no code). Name the code for an unknown proposal identifier, from N35-33.
Write variation 12 (machine, mac|trj, on every run entry) in derive.rs in the same change that receives MACHINE_NOT_LOCAL's number from N35-33; until then no surface offers --machine.
Allocate the protocol-family code MACHINE_NOT_LOCAL (exit 3) that N41-12 needs; NJL-01's variation 12 appends it once issued.

Write variation 13 (engine input for an entry whose engines lists more than native) in derive.rs, appending the engine-selection codes with pointer /engine (601 and 604 interim, replaced by the ledger's numbers).

Run NJL-01's scripts/e2e/verbs_registry_schema.sh stages 1-3, 5 and 6 as a stage of its registry-wide script. Check A step 5: compare against common_properties() and the full variation table (13 arms) rather than a hand list of 'three field-driven variations'; expect x-frob-key (never idempotency_key in required) and 808 by int53 field. Check A step 6 and verbs_lib.sh step 5: the missing-key 805 spot check needs N32a-09 (M1); before it, log a skip. Schema snapshots: a property added by a later variation (10 to 13) is classified additive.
Run NJL-01's script stage 7 (session focus without a key succeeds; session open --scopes design:read without a key is 805, exit 3) in its acceptance.

Map CLI flags to properties through common_properties() (its cli_flag field) instead of a hand map of --key and --estimate; parse the served refusal list from the short_doc form 'Refusals (FROB-REF-): n, n, ...'.
verb_invoke takes the common properties from common_properties() rather than a hand list.

session.show: rename its own session input (for example of_session) and drop its own limit, cursor and follow, which the paginated variation generates; the process option --session carries the caller's session and N32b-01 refuses another identifier with 802, so 'session show --transcript --session <other>' cannot reach the audit action. NJL-01's lint common-property-shadowed will fail the row as written.
Same rename as VERBS-session for the transcript's foreign-session argument of session.show.

ground.band's retire action is selected with --action retire (NJL-01: one action property on both surfaces, no per-action flag). The admin action gets no idempotency key from the generator; either drop 'takes its own idempotency key' or make retire a mutate action.

Conventions item 2 mirrors NJL-01's kinds table: update it to 808 by int53 field (not by kind), x-frob-key in place of a required idempotency_key, on_cancel leave|cancel_job, and the later variations 10 to 13 by reference to NJL-01's table rather than a copy.
Scripts use 'frob --root <dir>', which no bead defines: use the run's FROB_STATE exported by STD-E2E's e2e_init, and e2e_registries_scratch where a scratch registries root is meant.
Scripts use FROB_HOME, which frob does not read: use FROB_STATE from e2e_init (N00-29: target/e2e-work/ becomes the run's work/).

Your 'helper tests' in --test e2e_scripts are script checks: put each in crates/frob-conformance/src/e2e/checks/<name>.rs, call it from the script with e2e_check <name>, and name the tests <check>_... (STD-E2E).

Its script runs the tier targets through STD-E2E's e2e_tier, which finds the receipt as the one file that appears under target/gauntlet/receipts/ during the run and logs its hash; this checks STD-E2E's receipt logging. Optionally print the receipt's file name as the last line of the run so the helper need not compare directory listings.
STD-E2E's lint self-recording exempts only your scripts (record_gate.sh, status_accounting.sh); confirm they write a scratch copy of registries/gates.toml, never the one of record.
The catalogue registry/counterexamples.toml now has one parser, STD-TEST's Counterexamples; your loader (counts, join, FACT rerun check) runs as validation on its rows.

STD-TEST's types now carry your specimen records field for field (Row; RelationRow, renamed because of your Relation trait). assert_ka reports only the tolerance and control obligations; the derivation, rerun and unreconciled states remain your computed eligibility over the evidence lines.
Its reviewed list of environment variables names FROB_STATE but not FROB_REGISTRIES_ROOT, which N32ax-03 reads; add it (STD-E2E's e2e_registries_scratch sets it).
